tools.name: check_citation
tools.description: Check whether one public page supports one claim. Returns verdict supported, partially_supported, unclear, or unsupported, plus score, confidence, page_title, and method. score is the share of claim words found on the page, from 0 to 1, not a legal grade. Costs 0.08 credit only after the page is fet

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_citation · Private data: check_citation · Public sink: check_citation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_citation · Private data: check_citation · Public sink: check_citation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
